snp5.14:1.4: who is perfect in all things,
snp5.14:1.5: I have come in need with a question:
snp5.14:1.6: please tell of freedom through knowledge,
snp5.14:2.1: “The giving up of sensual desire, Udaya,
snp5.14:2.5: and the constraint of worry (about wrong-doing),
snp5.14:3.2: preceded by thought of impermanent things,
snp5.14:3.3: this I call freedom through knowledge, the breaking up of ignorance.”
snp5.14:4.1: “By what is the world fettered? said venerable Udaya,
snp5.14:4.2: By what does it roam about?
snp5.14:4.3: By completely giving up what thing is there what is called Nibbāna?”
snp5.14:5.1: “The world is fettered by enjoyment, Udaya, said the Fortunate One,
snp5.14:5.3: By completely giving up craving there is what is called Nibbāna.”
snp5.14:6.1: For he who lives mindfully, how is it consciousness ceases?
snp5.14:6.3: We have come to ask the Fortunate One,
snp5.14:6.4: therefore may we hear your word.”
snp5.14:7.1: “Without rejoicing over feeling on the inside or outside -
snp5.14:7.3: for he who lives mindfully in this way, consciousness ceases.”
